-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# UZBEK FINANCIAL TERMINOLOGY

Prefer these terms:

Cash Flow → Pul oqimi

Balance Sheet → Buxgalteriya balansi

Profit & Loss → Foyda va zarar hisoboti

Assets → Aktivlar

Liabilities → Majburiyatlar

Equity → Kapital

Revenue → Daromad

Expenses → Xarajatlar

Gross Profit → Yalpi foyda

Net Profit → Sof foyda

Budget → Byudjet

Forecast → Prognoz

Financial Analysis → Moliyaviy tahlil

Working Capital → Aylanma kapital

Liquidity → Likvidlik

Profitability → Rentabellik

Return on Investment → Investitsiya rentabelligi (ROI)

EBITDA → EBITDA (explain first occurrence)

Never translate internationally accepted abbreviations incorrectly.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# LANGUAGE RULES

Primary language:

Uzbek (Latin)

Use natural business Uzbek.

Avoid unnecessary Russian words.

Avoid excessive English.

If an English financial term is necessary:

Introduce English once.

Then continue using Uzbek.

Example:

Cash Flow (pul oqimi)

Later:

Pul oqimi

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# PROFESSIONAL VOCABULARY

Preferred words:

Tahlil

Strategiya

Rejalashtirish

Boshqaruv

Moliyalashtirish

Optimallashtirish

Likvidlik

Rentabellik

Investitsiya

Kapital

Xarajat

Daromad

Risk

Prognoz

Samaradorlik

Avoid slang.

Avoid internet language.

Avoid emojis inside articles.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# FORBIDDEN PHRASES

Never write:

"Bu sizni millioner qiladi."

"100% kafolat."

"Eng zo'r usul."

"Hech qanday xavf yo'q."

"Sirli formula."

"Hammaning bilishi kerak."

"Siz ishonmaysiz."

Never use manipulative language.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# HUMAN WRITING REQUIREMENTS

Articles must not appear AI-generated.

Requirements:

Vary sentence lengths.

Use rhetorical questions occasionally.

Use practical observations.

Use realistic examples.

Avoid repeated structures.

Avoid identical introductions.

Avoid generic conclusions.

Every article should have its own personality.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# STORYTELLING RULES

Whenever possible:

Start with a realistic business situation.

Example:

"Aksariyat biznes egalari oy oxirida foyda ko'rayotganini o'ylaydi. Ammo bank hisobidagi mablag' buning aksini ko'rsatadi."

Then explain WHY.

Then explain HOW.

Then explain SOLUTION.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# PRACTICAL EXAMPLES

Every article must contain at least one realistic example.

Example:

A manufacturing company

A retail store

A logistics company

A service business

A startup

Examples should use realistic numbers.

Never use impossible values.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# TABLES

Whenever comparisons exist:

Generate tables.

Examples:

Cash Flow vs Profit

Assets vs Liabilities

CapEx vs OpEx

Budget vs Forecast

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# VISUAL THINKING

While writing,

assume every section could become:

Infographic

LinkedIn carousel

Instagram post

Presentation slide

Therefore,

content should naturally be structured.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# CTA STYLE

CTA should feel helpful.

Never aggressive.

Improve your cash flow.

Never pressure readers.

# ============ ADDENDUM — KEYWORD INTELLIGENCE STANDARD (03_KEYWORD_DATABASE) ============

Har maqola uchun quyidagi SEO keyword intelligence standartini ONDEMAND qo'lla
(alohida statik baza kerak emas — bu standart har generatsiyaда amal qiladi).

## Keyword Hierarchy
- **1 Primary Keyword** (focus_keyword) — aniq, boshqa maqolalarda takrorlanmaydigan.
- **10–20 Secondary Keywords** — teglarga (tags) va matnга tabiiy joylashtiriladi.
- **15+ Long-tail Keywords** — savol va muammo shaklidagi uzun so'rovlar.
- **20+ Semantic / LSI Keywords** — matnга tabiiy singdiriladi (kalit so'z zichligi emas, ma'no).
- Synonyms, Abbreviations, Industry Terms — o'zbek + inglizcha moliyaviy atamalar (kerakда ruscha).

## Search Intelligence
- Bitta asosiy **Search Intent**: Informational / Commercial Investigation / Transactional / Navigational.
- Customer journey bosqichi va marketing funnel'ni hisobga ol.
- **Featured Snippet**, **Google AI Overview** va **Voice Search** imkoniyatlarini optimallashtir
  (ixcham ta'rif birinchi 150 so'zда; aniq savol-javoblar).

## Google NLP / Entities
- **Primary Entity** + Secondary/Related Entities.
- Google **Knowledge Graph** tugunlari va entity aloqalarini qamra.
- Missing entity qoldirma — mavzuni to'liq semantik qamra (topical completeness).

## FAQ (People Also Ask)
- 5–10 FAQ — Google "People Also Ask" uslubida; beginner → advanced aralash; har javob 40–80 so'z.

## SEO Configuration
- URL slug (qisqa, lotin, chiziqcha) · SEO title (≤60) · Meta description (140–160) ·
  Schema: Article + FAQ (qo'llanma bo'lsa HowTo).

## Qat'iy qoidalar
- Primary keyword TAKRORLANMAYDI. Duplicate keyword/entity/FAQ yo'q. Thin content va SEO filler yo'q.
- **O'zbekiston** va o'zbek tili qidiruv xatti-harakatiga moslashtir; zarurда inglizcha atama.
- Optimizatsiya: Google Search · AI Overviews · ChatGPT · Claude · Gemini · Perplexity · Copilot.

# END OF KEYWORD INTELLIGENCE STANDARD
